name: Indian Bank
title: Indian Bank - 532814 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Indian Bank FY26 beat most guidance with advances +13.43% and gross NPA down to 1.98%, but FY27 guides NIM 3.10–3.25%, ROA 1.20–1.30%, and ECL absorption is still unquantified.

triggers.label: NIM guide FY27 3.10–3.25%
triggers.quote: I don't see further rate cuts, but cost of deposit, I expect that it will remain elevated

triggers.label: Credit cost and slippage held under 1%
triggers.quote: Credit cost, we'll maintain less than 1%. Slippage ratio, we'll maintain less than 1%.

triggers.label: Advances +13.43%, MSME +81% sanctions
triggers.quote: Advance has grown by 13.43% and primarily contributed by RAM sector.

triggers.label: ECL impact to be absorbed in 1–3 quarters
triggers.quote: we will be able to absorb all the impact in, say, six to nine months, maybe between one to three quarters

guidance.quote: we are giving deposit guidance between 9% to 11%
so I'm giving guidance between 3.10% to 3.25%
ROA also, I'm giving some guidance between 1.20% to 1.30%.
gross NPA between 1.50% to 1.60%, net NPA at the same level
So, giving guidance of between Rs 4,500 crore to Rs 5,500 crore.
maybe around R s 1,000 crore, R s 1,200 crore profit we will earn through treasury.
CASA, approximately, we will maintain around 40%.
Credit cost, we'll maintain less than 1%.

prior_guidance_check.quote: We have given guidance of between 3.15% to 3.30%, so we have maintained that.
we ended up for the year at 46.03%
We have given guidance of between Rs 5,500 crore to Rs 6,500 crore.
We have given guidance of 40%, so 39.67% almost we have maintained.
We have given guidance of Rs 2,000 crore and actually we surpassed that.

red_flags.label: Treasury profit falling; FY26 supported by securities sales
red_flags.quote: this year treasury profit may not be to the extent it was last year.

red_flags.label: Large unquantified ECL provisioning
red_flags.quote: we will give you concrete numbers so that variation is minimum

red_flags.label: Bulk and CD share ~18-19% of deposits
red_flags.quote: Bulk and CD taken together around 18% to 19%.

evasions.quote: We will give you concrete numbers so that variation is minimum.
They do not even tell me. My CFO is very hard nut.
